routeHint: The anchor image of the chapter-leader kit: what a chapter officer sees the moment they sign in. Session slug t187c-chapter is Maya Costa (user 312917, maya.costa.312917@example.org), a Virginia Beach member of Northwind Professional Association who holds Chapter Vice-Leader (HR_LOCAL) and Chapter Treasurer (FINANCIAL_LOCAL) over local center 15658 and nothing else. Open it with: ORGO_DOCS_PASSWORD='...' node capture/login-member.mjs maya.costa.312917@example.org t187c-chapter. The sidebar here is the COMMUNITY mode sidebar and is deliberately almost identical to the administrator's - the difference between the two roles lives one click away, in Administration mode (see chapter-leader-sidebar-administration). The two visible differences on this screen are the missing settings gear beside the logo in the header, and the shorter group list.
alt: The Orgo dashboard as a chapter leader sees it: welcome banner and discussion feed in the centre, the community sidebar on the left with Home, Members, Events, Files, Courses, Voting, Chapters and Analytics, and voting, events and suggested-group widgets on the right
notes: Compare with /images/platform/home/member-dashboard.png, the same screen as an organisation administrator. The chapter leader has no settings gear in the header and no MY TASKS widget, and the sticky footer offers the Administration mode switch because hasAdminAccess in AppSidebarMenu.vue:1959 is satisfied by HR_LOCAL or FINANCIAL_LOCAL alone.

routeHint: Dashboard, then the Administration link in the sticky footer of the sidebar. This is where the chapter leader's view actually narrows: eight entries in two sections (FINANCE: Local products, Fee payments, Local members fees, Fees settings; MANAGEMENT: Adhesions, Badges, Resignation requests, Transfer requests). The mode is Vuex state (setSidebarMode, store.js:368) persisted to localStorage by vuex-persistedstate, so a fresh session always starts in community mode and the click is required. Gate the shot on 'Local members fees', which cannot exist until the mode has switched. 2026-11-11 recapture, root cause chain for the session t187c-chapter (Maya Costa 312917): (1) the capture still landed on the first-login wizard /hello-member although the pPrivacyRead and related notification_settings flags were set, because the account had no user_option row (isPrivacyUnset in store.js is true when user.privacy is null) and the saved session state held a stale persisted Vuex user. Seeded: INSERT INTO user_option (user_id,created_at,updated_at,age,name,email,phone,social,image,town,profession,profile,has_seen_profile_completion_celebration) VALUES (312917,now(),now(),0,1,0,0,0,1,1,0,0,1), then re-opened the session once through the wizard (Finish) and saved it back into capture/state-t187c-chapter.json with a Playwright storageState write (no password needed). (2) Maya then had no Administration switch because the reset left her with no user_role rows and no permissions. Role.permissions is empty for every role of tenant 282, so instead of editing roles (which would change dozens of other holders) she was given: INSERT INTO user_role (role_id,user_id,unit_id,date_created) VALUES (2847,312917,NULL,'2026-02-11'),(2857,312917,15658,'2026-02-11'),(2858,312917,15658,'2026-02-11'); UPDATE user SET custom_permissions='["HR_LOCAL","FINANCIAL_LOCAL"]', permissions='["FINANCIAL_LOCAL","HR_LOCAL"]' WHERE id=312917 (the stored form UserRoleService::computeCanonicalPermissions produces). Then cache:pool:clear cache.app cache.short. The menu has changed since August: Finance is Local products, Fee payments, Local members fees (no Fees settings any more), Management is Adhesions, Badges, Resignation requests, Transfer requests, and a Settings section with Waitlist was added. The Administration footer link is now a Community switch once in Administration mode, so the click still works from the community sidebar. Wired into platform/permissions-assigning.mdx on 2026-11-11 as the chapter half of a before-and-after comparison with the organisation admin's sidebar, so the two shots have to stay in step: if one is recaptured the other should be too. prefWelcomeRead was set true on this account so the dashboard welcome banner is not in the frame.
alt: The Administration sidebar as a chapter leader sees it, with a Finance section holding Local products, Fee payments and Local members fees, a Management section with Adhesions, Badges, Resignation requests and Transfer requests, and a Settings section with Waitlist, plus a Community switch at the bottom
notes: Pair this with admin-sidebar-administration, captured from the same route in the same viewport. Note the product defect this image records: Fees settings is shown to a FINANCIAL_LOCAL holder, but its route /local/settings/fee is gated ADMIN_LOCAL (router.js:1597), so clicking it returns the member to the sign-in screen.

routeHint: Sidebar Chapters -> Virginia Beach -> Members, or the Members entry on the chapter page (LocalCenter/ShowContent.vue:102 pushes UserList with unit and discriminator). This is the chapter directory, 124 members of Virginia Beach and its three child chapters. The chapter leader lands in the card view, not the table: initIsGallery (User/List.vue:3074) defaults isGallery to !isGranted('ADMIN_TENANT'), so the gallery IS the permission-driven default and not a stale preference. Gate on 'Register member', which needs HR_LOCAL over this chapter and therefore cannot paint before the user payload has landed. Wired into platform/users/index.mdx on 2026-11-11, in the worked example of what a chapter treasurer sees.

routeHint: The same chapter directory as chapter-leader-members-chapter, signed in as the organisation administrator, for the side-by-side comparison. Same 124 members. routeHint: Administration mode -> Finance -> Local members fees. This is the chapter fee screen a chapter treasurer works in, not the organisation one: the Local toggle shows the Virginia Beach fee tiers with their own prices, tick boxes per period, a running total and Save and Pay. The route pins itself to the signed-in officer's own chapter - asking for localCenter=15665 (Chesterfield) still renders Member fees - Virginia Beach, which is the scope substitution the kit should explain. router.js:2261 has no hasAppSidebarMenu, so the app renders this route without the left sidebar; that is the product's layout, not a broken capture. Gate on the Pay button, which only exists on the Local tab: the Organisation tab totals 0 and shows Save alone. Do NOT gate on a fee-tier label such as 'Annual (30 usd)' - it is the selected option of a select element and a Playwright text= locator never sees it. If the amount on the button changes the run reports waitFor MISSED, which is the intended signal that the staged fee_temporary rows have moved. 2026-11-11 recapture: the staged fee_temporary rows that made 'Pay 150 usd' are gone (Total: $0, Save only, no Pay button), and the currency now renders as $140 style, not '150 usd'. The route and the Local toggle are unchanged. The shot now ticks three unpaid period boxes on the Local tab (the first .b-checkbox labelled 25, 60 and 55, which are Oliver Ashford, Clara Ashford and Freya Dubois), a client-side selection only: nothing is saved or paid, and the Pay $140 button and Total: $140 appear. If the fee amounts change, change the three labels and the waitFor. Session and permission setup for Maya Costa is described under chapter-leader-sidebar-administration. Known oddity in frame: most members' Fee tier select is empty and only Maya Costa shows Annual ($30), a demo data state, not touched.
alt: The chapter member fees screen as a chapter leader uses it, with the Organisation and Local toggle set to Local, a fee tier selector per member, tick boxes for the 2026 period with three ticked, a running total of $140 and the Save and Pay $140 buttons

routeHint: Chapter page -> Events. The four events that belong to Virginia Beach (200396-200399) are the only unit-scoped events in this tenant and they are all in June 2025, so the Upcoming tab renders 'No future events at this moment'. The click on 'View past events' is what makes the list show anything; without it the capture is an empty state. Gate on an event title so the shot cannot fire before the past list has loaded. 2026-11-11 recapture: after the data reset events 200396 to 200399 were renamed with a Williamsburg suffix and had no unit, so /events?unit=15658 read No event added yet in this group. Seeded: UPDATE event SET unit_id=15658, name=REPLACE(name,"Williamsburg","Virginia Beach") WHERE id BETWEEN 200396 AND 200399 AND tenant_id=282 (still the four June 2025 events: Industry Site Visit, Grants Information Session, Certification Exam Preparation, Strategy Away Day, now all Virginia Beach). The click and waitFor are unchanged; the cache pools cache.app and cache.short were cleared.
alt: The chapter group page for Virginia Beach with the Discussions, Events, Files, Members and Analytics tabs and the Past events list showing the four Virginia Beach events for June 2025 with date, time, venue, price and programme, above the Upcoming and Past switch and the List and Calendar toggle

routeHint: Reached honestly: the chapter leader opens Richmond (local center 15659, a chapter she has no permission over) and clicks one of its role holders. Oliver Dubois (user 312676) keeps his profile private, so UserGetController::checkProfilePrivacy throws AccessDeniedException; the profile page cannot render, Show.vue:102 returns the member to the dashboard and the red toast is the only thing that says why. SETUP, already applied on the docs database: INSERT INTO user_option (user_id, created_at, updated_at, age, name, email, phone, social, image, town, profession, profile, has_seen_profile_completion_celebration) VALUES (312676, NOW(), NOW(), 0,1,0,0,0,1,1,0,1,0). A private member disappears from every member list and from search, which is why the capture is driven from the chapter page role-holder cards, the one surface that still links to them. The toast lives 5000 ms, so it MUST be triggered by the click at the end of the action list - a spec that navigates straight to /user/312676 shoots a dashboard with no toast on it at all, because the runner's own load waits are longer than the toast. The 'wait 2000' is load-bearing in the other direction: the runner adds 1200 ms after a click and 1500 ms before the shot, so the total 4700 ms is the only window in which the dashboard behind the toast has finished painting (at 3200 ms it is still grey skeleton bars) and the toast has not yet expired (about 5200 ms). 2026-11-11 recapture: the click target Oliver Dubois had vanished from the Richmond page for two reasons. (1) Role holders on a parent chapter page are fetched with role.isLocalCenterParent=1 (LocalCenter/ShowContent.vue:775) and tenant 282 has no such role after the reset, so the panel read No team members assigned yet (the two Richmond leaders are INACTIVE anyway, and the list filters user.status=ACTIVE). (2) The user_option privacy row for 312676 was gone. Seeded: INSERT INTO role (tenant_id,name,name_plural,position,is_local_center_parent,permissions) VALUES (282,"Regional Coordinator","Regional Coordinators",20,1,"[]") (id 3591); INSERT INTO user_role (role_id,user_id,unit_id,date_created) VALUES (3591,312676,15659,"2026-02-11"); INSERT INTO user_option (user_id,created_at,updated_at,age,name,email,phone,social,image,town,profession,profile,has_seen_profile_completion_celebration) VALUES (312676,NOW(),NOW(),0,1,0,0,0,1,1,0,1,0). The old SETUP insert in this hint is superseded by the one here. The Maya Costa session and permission setup is described under chapter-leader-sidebar-administration. Clicking the card now lands on /user/312676, is refused, and the toast shows over the dashboard.
waitFor: text=You do not have permission to view this profile
alt: The permission refusal a chapter leader gets outside their own chapter: a red banner reading You do not have permission to view this profile, over the dashboard the member has just been returned to
notes: Orgo has no dedicated Access Denied page. Out of scope produces one of three things and this is the only one with words on it. The second is a bounce to the sign-in screen, which is what any route carrying a meta.role the member lacks does (App.vue:688 pushes Login, not an error page) - it cannot be captured by this runner at all, because run.mjs treats a final URL containing /login as a failed session and refuses to write the file. The third is silent scope substitution, as on the chapter fees route.
